weather.divergence: Read: one of the eight divergence checks is lit, the RSI check, with 10 individual RSI warnings across the markets Crown reads; the other seven are quiet. Crown's own note applies: no single warning is a reason to sell, they matter when several point the same way as breadth, and breadth is broadening, so they do not agree today.
weather.call: Read: Crown calls BROADENING_CARRY, a partial fit with its size dial at 1.00 (a multiplier on the PM's own risk, not an Aegis size). It meets broadening, range not extreme, normal dispersion and low trend-fund flip risk, and misses positive dealer gamma. The scenario layer leads with DOLLAR_SQUEEZE at 0.75 (a share of conditions met, not a probability), INFLATION_SHOCK next, not contested; credit (high yield, flat) is the missing confirmation. Next scheduled tests: durable goods Tue 27 Oct 20:30 SGT, FOMC Wed 28 Oct 14:00 ET (02:00 SGT Thu), core PCE and GDP Thu 29 Oct 20:30 SGT.
weather.cot: Read: this is the report dated 20 Oct. Speculators are crowded long the Nasdaq 100 (NQ), Russell 2000 (RTY), 5-year note (ZF), 2-year note (ZT) and soybeans (ZS), and crowded short crude oil (CL), natural gas (NG) and silver (SI). For equities the crowded Nasdaq and Russell longs matter most: crowded longs are fuel for a fall if the tape breaks. Crowded short crude means a sharp oil rally can force covering, the tailwind the energy names in the room are already riding. It is a slow positioning read, not a timing signal.
